shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A woman in an emerald blouse sits at the sink-side guest stool and asks a question, and a woman in a mustard cardigan sits at the sink-end stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.

shots.content: A man in a charcoal sweater enters to the refrigerator-side guest stool and answers the woman in an emerald blouse.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald blouse replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the kitchen island, centered on the worktop, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.
